pages.text: Tamed with 13 beef and found in plains biomes, where each wild one lives at a ground nest of one or two eggs that it patrols and fiercely guards: stay away from the nest, and never break an egg. They can be mounted and ridden at high speed, and will also fight alongside you. While riding, [Space] makes it leap, farther the faster it's running,, [V] dashes forward in the direction you're moving, and [C] toggles a reckless peck: it hammers the ground ahead of it, hurting everything in reach, until you toggle it off or it tires. When tamed they receive a boost in health and speed. They are bred with glyptodon meat! Made to sit or stand by shift clicking. They can be healed with beef.
